results.description: I would die to recover an old family heirloom lost long ago.
I owe my life to the person who saved me from ruin.
Everything I do is for the common people.
I'm searching for a way to cure a debilitating illness.
My tools are symbols of my past life, and I carry them everywhere.
I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
I have sworn an oath to a god I no longer believe in.
I would burn the world down to bring back the family I lost.
I owe everything I am to the person who trained me.
I carry a letter I've never had the courage to send.
I once served in a war, and I've never truly left it behind.
I am the last of my bloodline, and I intend to see it continue.
I made a promise to a dying friend that I have yet to keep.
I answer to a patron whose true nature I don't fully understand.
I owe a debt to a criminal organization that I can never repay.
My silence was bought once, and I've been paid ever since.
I would sell out anyone to protect the person who raised me.
I serve a master whose orders I never question.
I built something terrible once, and I intend to finish it.
I keep the company of monsters because they never lied to me.
I owe my freedom to someone I would now rather forget.
Every coin I earn goes toward buying back a debt I can't discuss.
I made a deal I didn't understand at the time, and it's coming due.
I once had a home, and I mean to take it back by any means necessary.
I follow the person who spared my life, wherever that leads.
I keep a shrine to a god that everyone else has forgotten.
I was raised by wolves, in every sense of the word.
I owe my skill to a teacher I ultimately betrayed.
I would do anything to see my rival humbled.
I carry the ashes of someone I couldn't save.
I've sworn to finish what my mentor started, whatever the cost.
I am bound to a contract written in blood, mine or someone else's.
I protect a secret that would ruin someone I love if it ever got out.
I owe my life to a stranger I never got the chance to thank.
I would trade any number of strangers' lives for my own family's safety.
I serve the guild that saved me from starving as a child.
I keep a promise to someone who is no longer alive to release me from it.
My loyalty belongs to whoever holds my true name.
I was cursed once, and only one person knows how to lift it.
I raised a child that isn't mine, and I'd die before I let harm reach them.
I owe my strength to a ritual I'd rather not explain.
I follow the last order given to me by a commander long dead.
I keep the last letter from someone I failed to protect.
I would betray any cause for the chance to see my name cleared.
I serve a cult that saved me when no one else would.
I owe a blood debt that only violence can settle.
I carry a weapon that isn't mine to keep, and one day its owner will want it back.
I made a vow of silence about something I witnessed, and I intend to keep it.
I was the only survivor of something terrible, and I owe it to the rest to remember.
I keep faith with a god that everyone else says is dead.
I serve whoever pays best, and I have never once broken that arrangement.
I would burn every bridge I have to protect the one person who never judged me.
I owe my current name to someone who helped me disappear.
I keep a map to a place I've sworn never to return to.
I protect a village that doesn't know what I did to keep it safe.
I made a bargain with something that isn't entirely mortal.
I owe my education to a teacher I later helped destroy.
I carry a child's toy that belonged to someone I couldn't save.
I have sworn vengeance on the ones who wronged my family, whatever it costs.
I would give up any treasure to recover what was stolen from my bloodline.
I serve the memory of a leader whose ideals I no longer fully share.
I owe my life to a healer who asked for nothing but silence in return.
I keep watch over a grave that no one else visits.
I've sworn to protect a secret order, even from those closest to me.
I owe my current fortune to a theft I've never confessed to.
I would follow my old commander into any battle, even a losing one.
I keep a promise to raise my sibling's children as my own.
I serve a noble house that doesn't know its debts have come due.
I owe my safety to someone I've never actually met in person.
I carry the last words of a friend who didn't survive our escape.
I have pledged my sword to a cause I secretly doubt.
I would risk everything to see the ones who hurt me suffer in turn.
I owe my life to a demon, and the terms were never entirely clear.
I keep a lock of hair from someone whose name I refuse to speak.
I serve a temple that saved me from a fate I won't discuss.
I owe an old friend a favor that could get us both killed.
I carry a debt of honor from a duel I should have lost.
I protect the descendants of the family I once wronged.
I would trade my own life to undo a single decision from my past.
I owe my current skills to a criminal who taught me everything I know.
I keep the company of the only people who've never asked about my past.
I've sworn to finish a war my parents started and never ended.
I owe my loyalty to a spirit bound to the land where I was born.
I carry a ring that belongs to someone I failed to marry.
I would give anything to see my hometown rebuilt.
I serve a patron who saved my life and now owns a piece of my soul.
I owe a debt to the dead that only more death can settle.
I keep the last promise made to me by someone I loved and lost.
I protect a secret that, if revealed, would start a war.
I would abandon any principle to keep my crew alive.
I owe my current identity to a mistake I've never corrected.
I carry the banner of a cause that everyone else has given up on.
I serve the only person who ever showed me kindness, no matter what they ask of me.
I owe my life to a pact I signed without reading closely enough.
I keep watch for a monster that only I believe is still out there.
I would sacrifice a stranger without hesitation to protect my own.
I owe my current wealth to a partner I intend to eventually betray.
I carry the guilt of a job that went wrong, and someone else paid for it.
I serve an order that demands absolute obedience, and I've never once refused.
I would follow the one who freed me from bondage into the darkest places imaginable.
